NO_ALTERNATIVE_AVAILABLE.meaning: no authorized existing alternative is available

SOURCE_INVALID.meaning: source or identity violates the frozen source contract

PROVENANCE_MISSING.meaning: one or more mandatory provenance fields are absent

ALTERNATIVE_CERTIFICATION_FAILED.meaning: fresh C0/L1/L2/L3 chain did not establish a certified alternative

ALTERNATIVE_SEARCH_BLOCKED_BY_DEADLINE.meaning: deadline state does not authorize starting alternative evaluation

UNKNOWN_SOURCE.meaning: source type or source authority cannot be established
